title: Find the Longest Substring Containing Vowels in Even Counts
summary: Determine the length of the longest substring in which the count of each vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') is even.
statement: Determine the length of the longest substring in which the count of each vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') is even.
constraints: A substring qualifies when a,e,i,o,u each occur an even number of times.
Other lowercase letters do not change vowel parity.
hints: Encode five vowel parities as a five-bit mask.
Equal masks at two prefix positions mean every intervening vowel count is even.
Store the earliest index for each mask and maximize the distance on repeats.
The earliest equal state always gives the longest substring ending at the current index.
editorial: The earliest equal state always gives the longest substring ending at the current index.

tests.explanation: The longest valid substring has length thirteen.
A parity-state prefix match identifies the longest valid range.
